profile.entities: Exide Industries Limited; Exide Energy Solutions (subs)
profile.subseg: Lead-acid batteries; Lithium-ion cells; Home UPS; Industrial UPS; 2W/4W OEM; 2W/4W replacement; Solar; Telecom; Exports
profile.themes: Make in India lithium-ion; GST 2.0 demand surge; Commodity inflation pass-through; Telecom shift to Li-ion; Export recovery potential

bull_bear.body: Rs. 4,802 cr allocated to Exide Energy (Li-ion subsidiary); no dividend or buyback mentioned; focus on capex over shareholder returns; HDFC Life stake mark-to-market loss of Rs. 850 cr routed to OCI, no sale
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Commodity volatility (sulfur, plastic, LPG, lead, lithium); rupee depreciation; geopolitical disruption to exports; lithium-ion yield ramp-up delays; OEM contract lag in price pass-through; government policy delay for PLI/incentives
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident on core business resilience, cautiously optimistic on macro, strongly committed to Make in India Li-ion, proactive on price hikes, transparent on challenges, seeking policy support
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Sulfuric acid cost surge is tied to petrochemical refinery utilization (sulfur byproduct), not just demand; Exide’s Li-ion pricing strategy hinges on China’s VAT hike (9% increase by Jan 2027) and localization incentives; Telecom decline is structural, not cyclical — Li-ion replacement is permanent; 92% of business grew double-digit despite 8% decline in exports/Telecom
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Domestic business ex-Telecom grew 16% in Q4; 2W/4W OEM: +25% YoY (2nd straight quarter); Home UPS: record Q4 sales; Solar: crossed Rs. 1,000 cr annual revenue; Industrial UPS ex-Telecom: double-digit growth; Exports: declined due to geopolitics; Telecom & E-Rickshaw: shifting to Li-ion
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: Gross margin down 90 bps QoQ to 30.1% due to Rs. 150 cr net commodity impact; EBITDA margin held at 11.7% via cost controls, warranty reduction, and manufacturing excellence; sulfuric acid up 5x (Rs. 15/kg to Rs. 75/kg); plastic and LPG also pressured; price hikes implemented in Jan, Mar, Apr (cumulative 5-6%, April hike: 3%)
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: high single-digit to early double-digit YoY for FY27 core business; margin: EBITDA to be sustained via price hikes and cost controls; order inflow: strong in industrial UPS, railways, solar; capex/commissioning: Rs. 1,400 cr planned for FY27; cylindrical Li-ion trials starting May 2026, prismatic trials by June-July 2026
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Healthy order inflow in railways, motive power, industrial UPS; no specific value disclosed
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Lithium-ion cell manufacturing (6 GW capacity: 3 GW cylindrical for 2W/3W EVs, 3 GW prismatic for 4W EVs, BESS, Telecom); solar vertical scaling; export recovery in EU/US; industrial UPS demand from data centers and BESS
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Exide delivered record Q4 revenue and expanded EBITDA margin despite severe commodity inflation, driven by strong domestic demand across auto OEM, UPS, and solar verticals; the company is now pivoting to lithium-ion cell manufacturing with Rs. 4,802 cr invested, positioning itself as India’s first integrated Li-ion producer to capture EV and stationary storage growth, while navigating volatile input costs through staged price hikes and OEM contract renegotiations.
